programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the director's three most popular 'Venoms,' Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A group of top martial artists try to unveil the truth surrounding a bloody parrot. However, the path ahead is fraught with many challenges.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Martial arts star Jimmy Wang Yu plays Kwei Wu, who unites with his wife Kan to battle kidnappers at the Red Lotus Temple.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The retired one-armed swordsman made his reappearance to fight against the brutal robbers and protect the peace of the martial art world.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by 'Drunken Master', this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist who creates a cricket-style fighting technique to defeat the pugilists who bested him before.

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hung (Gordon Liu) fights for balance in the martial world with the evil Lu school and a northern master in their employ.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer/ director Yueh Feng's most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh joins forces with Ni Kuang and martial arts choreographer Liu Chia-liang to craft this brilliant saga from the golden age of kung fu films.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A martial artist joins the police force in order to pursue the man who killed his best friend but it is only years later that he discovers a startling clue.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are saved by Master Lian during a botched exorcism and they beseech him to teach them. Then his friend is killed and with his master's help, Lu avenges him.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: A Shaw kung fu classic from 1984, this film depicts the trials of a young hero who sets out to avenge his parents' death.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: In this film, award winning actor Ku Feng stars as the 'Whip Devil' alongside Shih Szu as the 'The Lady Hermit' against the masters of mayhem.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The first make HK$1 million at the local box office, Chang Cheh's Wuxia film sparked a new age in martial arts films with its male anti-heroes and violence.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: A young woman's life turns tragic after she discovers that she's adopted and then goes in search of her real mother.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Lady of the Law
programme.desc: One of director Shen Chiang's last works, this action-packed adventure features a lone female fighter, decades before the dawn of pro-feminist kung fu films.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry King's famous 1950's film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Follow a virtuous viper as it sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a dangerous lady in this thriller!

programme.title: Empanadas For Everyone
programme.desc: Taco Night is no joke at Chef Eduardo’s Montana home, but here's a secret - he doesn’t always make tacos! Start a new trend with his Green Chile and Crab Empanadas, Pickled Charred Red Onions and a refreshing Avocado and Pico Salad and Lime Crema.

programme.title: New School Goulash and Spaetzle
programme.desc: Class is in session as Chef Tiffany takes us back in time and recreates a recipe that she perfected when she went back to school - Hungarian Goulash topped with a bright Dill Cream. On the side, a childhood favorite, crispy yet tender Spaetzle.

programme.title: Food Back from the Dead
programme.desc: Stale bread, old bananas, canned food, dry foods... they've all gotten a bad wrap, but this is not the end of them yet! Don't let this stuff sit in the pantry, don't let it go to waste - Frankie encourages you to stretch further and cheaper!

programme.title: Cauliflower's Star Power
programme.desc: Cauliflower is a star and can be transformed into unexpected dishes. Plus it's delicious and nutritious! Frankie reminds us to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes.

programme.title: Go For Game Day
programme.desc: When gathering to watch the game, it's important that everyone be chewing while they cheer! From peel-and-eat shrimp, to a jalapeno burger dog, and inside out nachos, we've got something for every fan.

programme.title: The Perfect Pairing
programme.desc: What’s better than your two favorite things coming together for the best bite ever? With pizza waffles, french fry corn dogs, and a pasta frittata, these dynamic duos will not disappoint.

programme.title: Erin O’Brien’s Pork My Buns XXXX
programme.desc: Artist and activist, Erin O’Brien, grinds up some homemade sausages and chats about using food as performance art. She and Ingrid stuff up her Pork My Buns XXXX to honor her friend Chris’s progressive work as a trans filmmaker.

programme.title: Parisa Parnian’s Ghormeh Sabzi
programme.desc: Designer and pop-up host, Parisa Parnian of Savage Muse, stirs up ghormeh sabzi and celebrates her LGTBQIA+ inclusive pop ups. She and Ingrid simmer this traditional Iranian dish as they discuss the importance of building your own community.

programme.title: Mac Elliot Jarvis’ Shakshuka
programme.desc: Chef Mac Elliot Jarvis serves up shakshuka and speaks about the kitchen being a safe space. He and Ingrid cook comfort food and chat about him using cooking to find confidence in transitioning.

programme.title: Jeff Danzer’s Cana-Caramel Apples
programme.desc: Cannabis advocate and chef, Jeff Danzer aka JeffThe420Chef, craves up caramel apple roses and chats about cannabis right. He and Ingrid roll up puff pastry and pontificate on the linked history of cannabis and gay rights.

programme.title: Chef Carter’s Philly Cheesesteaks & Crab Fries
programme.desc: Event curator and entrepreneur, Chef Carter, chops up cheesesteaks and chats about creating female friendly experiences in LA. She and Ingrid cut up this classic sandwich and celebrate being a strong woman in a restaurant.

programme.title: Michael Twitty’s Smoked Tea Greens
programme.desc: Food historian and activist, Michael Twitty, cooks up collard greens and chats about serving up food as social activism. He and Ingrid craft this classic comfort food while chatting about finding his voice and purpose through food.

programme.title: Happy Birthday to Me
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s birthday and he’s treating himself to some self love and a lavish steak dinner inspired by a famous NYC steakhouse. On the menu: Rib Eye Steak with Peppercorn Sauce, Duck Frites, Wedge Salad and a celebratory carrot cake.

programme.title: A South Carolina Family Reunion
programme.desc: For his reunion inspired menu Chef Derrell Smith is going back to his roots. Cookin’ up some modern takes on the family classics including his Garlic Pesto Potato Salad, Salmon Filet, a Herby, Spicy Kale Slaw, and Grilled Fruit Skewers.

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It’s not only good for your wallet, it’s good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

programme.title: Spooktacular Tricks and Treats
programme.desc: Don’t let the line of trick-or-treaters or the candy corn overload scare you out of the kitchen this Halloween. Frankie’s got tricks up his sleeve to make simple yet wicked good treats for everyone at the party to enjoy. All while saving some dough.

programme.title: Corn Cavatelli Cacio e Pepe & Summer Cobbler
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto uses the entire ear of corn to create custom creamy cacio e pepe cavatelli. We’re talking cob, kernel, and husk - and for dessert, he’s making a sweet summery strawberry cobbler that you won’t soon forget.

programme.title: Poolside Shrimp Taco Platter
programme.desc: Chef Angie Lee transports you to Baja, Mexico with her crispy tempura fried Baja shrimp tacos with salsa, black beans, and cilantro cauliflower rice. Corn salad with chipotle dressing adds a good crunch too!

programme.title: Seaside Scallops with a Salad and a Sweet
programme.desc: Chef Stuart O’Keeffe sears up some scallops with smashed crispy fingerlings and roasted tomatoes. He also dishes up an herbed salad, a light and refreshing vodka cocktail, and a fresh and creamy strawberry parfait.

programme.title: Hot Fried Chicken Sando on A Furikake Bun
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval serves up a hot fried chicken sandwich on a homemade furikake bun with Japanese mayo and southern-style slaw. On the side, he preps deliciously crispy hand-cut fries - dig in to this fried feast!

programme.title: Egg Yolk Raviolo with Whipped Ricotta
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto shows us the art of pasta making by creating a gorgeous raviolo. This pasta is filled with egg yolk and fluffy ricotta in a brown butter sauce. A tomato salad and orange blossom cookies finish it all off.

programme.title: Fab Friends

programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s grandma inspired him in life and in the kitchen. He shares family recipes taking him right back to grandma's table. He's cookin' up Fried Chicken, Mac ‘N Cheese, Collard Green Slaw, Brûlée Banana Pudding and Pop-pops moonshine.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Merseyside, Inspector Anthony Joynes receives an emergency call from an owner as his dog is in trouble and he can't get her to the vets. Staffie Sky is suffering from an infected uterus and she needs an emergency operation in order to save her life.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: A crazy animal expert raises hundreds of pets in their workplace; the super cute characteristics and breeding secrets of pet turtles are revealed; elementary school students' favorite beetle army attacks, tailor-made insect jelly taste super delicious; and animal therapist is now on duty, "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to visit a parent-child farm and get close to various cute pets.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes has heard reports of a dog being beaten in broad daylight and Animal Welfare Officer John Littlewood has found CCTV to back up the claim. The police agree that the dog is clearly suffering and they go in convoy with Anthony to visit the dogs owner but he isn't going to let his dog Millie go without a fight.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has a heavyweight problem to tackle -V Kifarou, one of Flamingoland's male white rhinos, has a skin infection. At Matt's surgery, he operates on a kestrel with a broken wing. When wildlife rescuer Jean Thorpe arrives to collect the patient, Matt has another bundle for her, a poorly duck with suspected lead poisoning.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Greater Manchester shockingly injured Saluki Susie limps onto a petrol station forecourt and into Inspector Becky Goulding's life. Susie's found with football socks tied tightly around her legs. One fractured leg is damaged beyond repair and has to be removed. After Susie's sad start will she find her happy ending?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Essex Animal Collection officer Joe White's on his way to pick up a dog that's been left abandoned and tethered to the edge of a bridge. Last year the charity received over 63,000 reports of abandoned animals, and nearly half of those were dogs. When Joe arrives in Harlow, the lady who found the dog has moved him to a place of safety and is waiting with a couple of concerned neighbours. With his bones clearly visible through his already skinny frame, the poor dog is worryingly thin. programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. programme.title: Vacation Deluxe
programme.desc: In the middle of the Allgäu at the foot of the Alps, a holiday park of superlatives is being built on a gigantic area of 184 hectares! The construction of the new holiday park will cost a total of 350 million euros. Around 5000 guests are to spend their holidays in 1000 holiday homes. But it is still a long way to the opening: it is the largest building site southern Germany has ever seen. On this area, which is as big as 258 football fields, about one million holiday guests per year are expected soon. Around 1100 men are working at full capacity to ensure that everything is ready in time for the park's opening. 1000 holiday homes must be ready and habitable by then. A spa, an adventure pool, indoor playgrounds and 6 restaurants are also planned. The workers are under enormous time pressure. Will the mega holiday park be ready in time before the first guests arrive?

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E01 - Rookie Pressure
programme.desc: Anthony se esfuerza por demostrar su valía como médico jefe al responder a un accidente de moto de nieve en Togwotee Pass.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E02 - Home Safe
programme.desc: La primera prioridad de cada misión es la seguridad del equipo, así que cuando las condiciones en Pyramid Peak amenazan a Jake y Cody durante un rescate, Tim exige que echen el freno.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E01 - Antler Raiders
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛試圖控制人群，當大門打開時，角獅獵人被釋放以尋找他們的獎杯。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E02 - Across The Seeded Fields
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲護理員在第一天的雞頭鷂季節出動，密切監視合規與不合規的狩獵行為，確保播種田地不受損害。

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E03 - Breaking Terry Badly
programme.desc: 特里在《絕命毒師》中成為沃爾特·懷特的犧牲品，特里和拉里測試這部標誌性系列的3個獨立場景，其中兩個需要特效專家安德烈·艾林森的幫助，包括點燃一個氣罐和通過一扇鋼門進行化學燃燒。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E04 - Larry's Shadow
programme.desc: 拉里被特里的黑暗和神秘世界吸引，因為特里想測試1994年與亞歷克·鮑德溫一起拍攝的電影《暗影》的兩個場景。特里將發現他們是否能拯救一個被水泥鞋困住的男人，然後他們將進行一個看似不可能的測試。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Las estrellas son un poco como los seres humanos. Pueden ser cálidas o frías, tienen todo tipo de formas y tamaños... y, admitámoslo, pueden ser tenues o brillantes. Según recientes descubrimientos, sólo en nuestra galaxia, la Vía Láctea, hay más de 200.000 millones de estrellas. ¿Qué son estos ciudadanos del cielo nocturno?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E03 - Married to the Job
programme.desc: Jake y Marilynn cancelan una cena para poder atender a un esquiador herido en Teton Pass.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E04 - Juggled Lives
programme.desc: La ajetreada agenda del Dr. AJ Wheeler le mantiene fuera de combate, pero su equipo lucha contra los fuertes vientos en el helicóptero para salvar a un conductor de motos de nieve con el fémur roto. Luego recibe otra llamada y el Dr. Wheeler está allí, intentando rescatar a un hombre que cae por un acantilado de 60 metros.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E04 - Larry's Shadow
programme.desc: 拉里被特里的黑暗和神秘世界吸引，因為特里想測試1994年與亞歷克·鮑德溫一起拍攝的電影《暗影》的兩個場景。特里將發現他們是否能拯救一個被水泥鞋困住的男人，然後他們將進行一個看似不可能的測試。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Las estrellas son un poco como los seres humanos. Pueden ser cálidas o frías, tienen todo tipo de formas y tamaños... y, admitámoslo, pueden ser tenues o brillantes. Según recientes descubrimientos, sólo en nuestra galaxia, la Vía Láctea, hay más de 200.000 millones de estrellas. ¿Qué son estos ciudadanos del cielo nocturno?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E03 - Married to the Job
programme.desc: Jake y Marilynn cancelan una cena para poder atender a un esquiador herido en Teton Pass.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E04 - Juggled Lives
programme.desc: La ajetreada agenda del Dr. AJ Wheeler le mantiene fuera de combate, pero su equipo lucha contra los fuertes vientos en el helicóptero para salvar a un conductor de motos de nieve con el fémur roto. Luego recibe otra llamada y el Dr. Wheeler está allí, intentando rescatar a un hombre que cae por un acantilado de 60 metros.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E01 - Antler Raiders
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛試圖控制人群，當大門打開時，角獅獵人被釋放以尋找他們的獎杯。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E02 - Across The Seeded Fields
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲護理員在第一天的雞頭鷂季節出動，密切監視合規與不合規的狩獵行為，確保播種田地不受損害。

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E02 - Meateaters
programme.desc: Papua New Guinea Pt2. Jim brings meat to the local village while Corey explores leech infested swamps looking for the local deer. Local villagers tell Jim of a remote area 400 miles away where buffalo roam.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E09 - How Not to Get Eaten
programme.desc: Tras un ataque casi mortal en el norte de Florida, Manny decide educar al espectador y a los caimanes locales.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E10 - Hog Tussle
programme.desc: Manny Puig caza jabalíes en los bosques de palmitos del norte de Florida y es atacado por un jabalí de 90 kilos.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E01 - Manny Goes Medieval
programme.desc: Manny demuestra sus habilidades medievales, cogiendo un enorme jabalí con lanzas al estilo vikingo.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E02 - Drought and Danger
programme.desc: Manny investiga cómo la grave sequía ha provocado que la fauna salvaje se congregue cerca de cualquier agua.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E05 - Heartbreak Tuna Capetown
programme.desc: Mario ventures deep into the ocean off the coast of Cape Town in order to catch giant yellow fin tuna, but finds him self biting more than he can chew.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E06 - Getting Close to Black Death
programme.desc: In the wilds of northern South Africa, poaching is everywhere, and the wilderness couldn't be more dangerous. Mario wants to be the first person in the region to hunt a Cape buffalo using a bow and arrow.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E07 - Hawaii Access Shane Dorian
programme.desc: The number of axis deer in Hawaii has exploded, making them a big problem for this stunning Pacific paradise. In this episode, Mario meets up with Shane Dorian, a big wave surfer, as they head out on an expedition.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E08 - Talking Turkey Frank Stallone
programme.desc: Mario teams up with Frank Stalone and heads to Kansas to find Easton turkeys. With Frank's Italian roots, Mario is sure they can create turkey meatballs that taste incredible.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E09 - Alaska Deer Part 1
programme.desc: En las vastas tierras salvajes de Alaska, Laramy está al acecho de ciervos y hambriento de venado.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E10 - Mountain Lion
programme.desc: Known to attack from above, Mountain Lion can quickly change from hunted, to hunter. Laramy must keep his guard up as he stalks through these trees in search for a cat he calls Elk-Killer.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E11 - Alaska Deer Part 2
programme.desc: En las profundidades de Alaska, Laramy Miller está a la caza de grandes ciervos. Pero acechar a un animal en este campo abierto puede resultar todo un reto.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E12 - Trapping
programme.desc: Laramy muestra sus habilidades con las trampas mientras atrapa todo tipo de bichos cerca de su casa en la montaña.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E03 - Guts
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的野生動物管理員面臨著鹿狩獵季節第一天的挑戰和混亂。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E04 - Litica
programme.desc: 在國家的最偏僻地區工作以保護我們珍貴的自然資源意味著工作中從來不會有無聊的一天。

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life
programme.desc: La balsa sigue causando problemas mientras Chris y Casey gastan valiosas energías intentando mantenerse a flote. Con sus días en el Pacífico Sur menguando, los hermanos han llegado a su punto de ruptura'hasta que un nuevo descubrimiento deja un impacto duradero.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris y Casey han atravesado Nueva Zelanda a pie durante semanas. Luchar por sus vidas ha hecho mella en sus emociones y habilidades. Se asocian para cazar jabalíes, pero los alijos utilizados para sobrevivir crean nuevos retos y profundas frustraciones.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E05 - Getting to Know Rick O'Shea
programme.desc: 在這一集中，我們認識到拉里朋友Rick O'Shea（Ricochet）。Terry和Larry測試了幾部不同的電影，其中子彈被操縱以獲得驚人的效果。他們測試了來自Skyfall、自殺小隊、美國超人和《熊》的場景。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E06 - We Hear Ya!
programme.desc: 拉里和特里測試觀眾的多個請求。他們將測試來自《壞男孩2》、《危機警報》、《許可殺戮》和《曼谷危機》的瘋狂場景。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: ¿Cómo sobrellevan los astronautas la vida en el espacio? El entorno único, la falta de sabor de su comida y el olor a aire enlatado contribuyen al estrés de vivir y trabajar en el espacio.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E02 - Atmosphere
programme.desc: El cambio climático y la contaminación están teniendo consecuencias nefastas para la atmósfera de nuestro planeta, este episodio actualiza la última tecnología y la ciencia que estudia la salud de nuestro aire.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:05 - 3 in 1 Day
programme.desc: Para Jess, la vida en casa parece fuera de control. Sin embargo, la rutina de trabajo está controlada, incluso cuando el equipo se enfrenta a tres rescates sin precedentes en menos de doce horas.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E06 - Bombs Away
programme.desc: Jamie confía en la nueva tecnología de explosivos para mantener seguras las pistas de esquí y abiertas las carreteras locales durante todo el invierno. Pero su bombardeo de bombas antiavalanchas no basta para salvar a todo el mundo.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E05 - In The Drink
programme.desc: Los guardabosques de Montana manejan una variedad de problemas relacionados con el agua, como la basura, el consumo de alcohol por menores y el anualmente Yellowstone Boat Float. Su trabajo asegura la seguridad y la conservación de las vías fluviales de Montana, abordando las preocupaciones que surgen de las actividades recreativas durante las temporadas altas.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E06 - Warrants and Weed
programme.desc: 遊戲看守者經常必須處理不斷違規或有未解決逮捕令的人，這可能使他們接近時的情況變得複雜。

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E09 - The LZ
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer deben esforzarse para llegar a la zona de aterrizaje con una balsa que falla. Con sólo unas pocas horas antes de la extracción, ¿podrá la Madre Naturaleza sacar lo mejor de ellos antes de que puedan ponerse a salvo?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer, de vuelta de su dura experiencia en la naturaleza neozelandesa, comentan los altibajos y los momentos cruciales de su reciente aventura.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E07 - D-Day By Air
programme.desc: 特里回到跳傘學校，將看到對士兵而言，在D日以跳伞方式安全降落時，與敵人交戰是多麼困難。他將試著用3種不同的武器在空中下降時，擊中幾個目標。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E08 - Saving Private Terry
programme.desc: Terry有機會透過嘗試《拯救大兵瑞恩》中著名的狙擊手射擊來重溫他軍旅生涯的一部分，Larry和Terry演示了狙擊手技術如何隨著時間推移而發展，並測試一些驚人的狙擊手射擊。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: Las últimas actualizaciones sobre El nuevo hardware espacial a punto de lanzarnos a la próxima generación de vuelos espaciales algunos cohetes y cápsulas llegan a tiempo otros no tienen tanta suerte.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: La EXO Mars y el Curiosity continúan sus descubrimientos científicos mientras se preparan las nuevas misiones, tanto robóticas como tripuladas, al planeta rojo Marte.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E07 - Swoop and Scoop
programme.desc: Wiedie y Chris diseñaron sus vidas para poder experimentar todo lo que Jackson Hole tiene que ofrecer. Y cuando el primer paseo en moto de nieve de un joven se descontrola, unen sus fuerzas a las de Jess y Flip para ejecutar un rescate perfecto.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E08 - No Short Cuts
programme.desc: Tim exige mucho de todos los que le rodean, especialmente durante un rescate en una cueva, que él describe como el peor tipo de rescate.

programme.title: The Wedding in the Hamptons
programme.desc: Jenna is a fashion designer who works for her friend's boutique. Their failing business was saved by a famous influencer. When Jenna comes to a lavish Hamptons wedding, she was mistaken for her, but she decides to go along to save business

programme.title: Meet me in New York
programme.desc: Ambitious New York events planner Kelly is one of the best in the business. But when Joe, a stubborn, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's birthday, Kelly soon realizes that she may have met her match.

programme.title: Hashtag Proposal
programme.desc: 在兩個陌生人之間的假結婚求婚。當所有注意力開始幫助他們解決艱難的生活和事業時，Millie 和 Leo 假裝扮演，試圖忽視他們的感情。

programme.title: Behind the Wheel of Revenge
programme.desc: 金（Kim），大家都知道她是一名优秀的學生且人緣很好，但在一次家庭聚會上發生意外后，她陷入了大麻煩。她決定開車，卻不應該這樣做，結果失控撞車，甚至差點傷害到她的一位同班同學。這給她和舉辦派對的人的父母帶來了很多困擾。

programme.title: Sorority Secrets
programme.desc: 卡西(Cassie)非常高興加入一個精英姐妹會，作為年中轉校生，還享受免費住宿、學費援助以及出色的校友網絡。然而，當卡西發現姐妹會的會長和顧問正在與姐妹會的女孩們經營一個陪伴服務時，她意識到這個小秘密可能會要了她的命……

programme.title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
programme.desc: 伊芙和朋友偷偷跑去參加派對，但朋友卻不幸喪命，而伊芙也失去了大學獎學金。很快，她找到一份工作以支付學費，但這份工作卻是導致她朋友死亡的危險伴遊計劃的掩護。

programme.title: Killer Queen Bee
programme.desc: 迪倫因為母親進入藥物依賴康復中心而轉學。與高中惡女蒂芬妮發生衝突後，蒂芬妮開始策劃讓迪倫的生活變得地獄般艱難。

programme.title: Danger Rocks the Cradle
programme.desc: Nicolette, a high school senior has bounced around from foster home to home. She started feeling hopeless when found herself pregnant by the school quarterback.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: 當薩馬維亞的皇子來到鎮上尋找皇室麵包師時，麵包師艾莉和瑪莉蓮的對抗更加激烈。當艾莉和皇子產生好感時，似乎他尋找的不僅僅是一個出色的蛋糕。

programme.title: Modeled with Love
programme.desc: 當模型製作人奧莉薇亞的父親準備從公司退休時，她認為自己理所當然會接管公司。然而，擁有全局思維的西蒙的出現，威脅到不僅是奧莉薇亞的舒適圈，還有她作為繼任者的角色。

programme.title: Catfish Murder
programme.desc: 一位單親媽媽努力平衡成功的職業與家庭生活，但當她害羞的青少年兒子因為謀殺同校年輕女性而被逮捕，她的世界失控。

programme.title: Living Next to Danger
programme.desc: 慈善始於家庭，這句話是Roxanne Robinson重新思考的內容，當她的青春女兒失踪時，所有人開始責怪最近搬進她家後院的鄰居，他們看似完美的房子。

programme.title: Hashtag Proposal
programme.desc: 在兩個陌生人之間的假結婚求婚。當所有注意力開始幫助他們解決艱難的生活和事業時，Millie 和 Leo 假裝扮演，試圖忽視他們的感情。

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby，一位有抱負的浪漫小說作家，為了獲得有利可圖的書籍合約，參加了她的文學英雄和當下最熱門作家Marcus Harlow在塔霍主持的一個寫作研討會。但當戶外型酒店老闆Woody向她展示大自然的美麗時，Ruby開始懷疑自己是否寫了錯誤的故事來打動像Marcus這樣的人。

programme.title: Three Dates to Forever
programme.desc: Maddie Mckenzie is a hard-working presenter whose drive and talent has made her a popular radio host. John Reed is a carefree tech entrepreneur who's more interested in hosting parties. The two couldn't be more different.

programme.title: A View to Kill For
programme.desc: 莫莉和她的家人繼承了她遙遠父親的豪宅後，搬到了高尚的社區。然後，有人闖入並在他們的牆上塗寫了一個可怕的消息。

programme.title: Home for a Royal Heart
programme.desc: When the seaside town of Shaw Bay is under threat of a redevelopment, realtor Erin will do anything to save it. Cue the handsome Theo, a royal looking for a new property. The catch is, he's hiding the royal part.
